trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The lowdown: earn everything else and the platinum takes care of itself — 'a Leonida Legend', as the card says. Pops automatically when all 54 others are earned. Nothing to do but the whole list. (Cross-checked on .)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Story mission Gone Fishing, the game's cold open in Leonida. Unmissable if you finish the story. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1. Story progress cannot be lost once a mission is done. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Chapter 2 completion. The asterisked name is Rockstar's censor of the in-game chapter title. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Chapter 3 completion — the story reaches Vice City proper. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Chapter 4 completion, the last chapter before the finale. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Story final mission. Gold, 50G on Xbox. Earned on the credits roll. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Breakfast Run mission completion. Jason and Lucia's early chapter job. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The lowdown: The Cartel Heist, a 25G story heist mid-game. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Child's Play mission completion. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Headliners mission completion. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: The lowdown: VCIA Takedown mission completion, 25G. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Operation Savage Glory mission completion, 25G. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The lowdown: The big one: 100% completion, 100G. The completion checklist: all 55 trophies feed this. Finish story, all strangers, all activities, collectibles, robberies, and exploration. Track progress in the pause menu's completion meter. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The lowdown: 250 stunts total. Stunts are jumps, flips, and tricks scored by the game's stunt system. Farm them during free roam with fast bikes; each landing counts. Long grind — start early. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Try each of the 9 activity types once. One session of each: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation, hunting, challenges, and one more. Cheapest silver-to-bronne on the list — do it in an afternoon. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. Each range has courses; gold requires accuracy and time targets. Retry until gold — bronze runs do not count. Hardest activity gold. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. You only need first place, not all objectives. Map them in the Top Fun app in-game. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Win 20 different races — distinct tracks, not 20 wins on one circuit. Check the race app for the track list; win once per track. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the rival angler in the fishing strand. His challenge unlocks after the intro; winning needs the bigger catch of the session. (Cross-checked on Output Lag.)
sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Complete any one arcade game start-to-finish. Four cabinets exist in arcades; one full playthrough of any cabinets's game counts. (Cross-checked on Output Lag.)
sources: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List guide

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Andy's strand final mission. Andy's strand is a story-linked stranger chain; finish all his missions and this pops. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Kenton's strand finale. Complete the full chain for this hidden bronze. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Billy's strand finale. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida, silver. There are more than 8 strands; Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and more. The 8 easiest count. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Randy's strand finale. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Tyrone's strand finale. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Heads-up, this one can be missed: per The Games Wiki at least one meditation spot only exists during Chapter 1 — do the early ones before the story moves on. This is the list's known missable. (Cross-checked on The Games Wiki GTA 6.)
sources: The Games Wiki GTA 6 — Missable Content notes

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Hunt a unique GTA 6 animal for Bret, the hunting stranger. The unique animal appears in Bret's final hunt. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Complete 3 collectible card sets, silver. Cards are scattered collectibles; sets complete when a themed run is fully gathered. 30G. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: The lowdown: WAiNK It at 100 locations, silver. WAiNK is the in-game tagging mechanic; tag 100 of the marked spots around the map. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the short map objectives (stunt chains, photo tasks). 50 of any mix. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Lose a 4-star wanted level WITH your partner and escape. Both characters wanted at 4 stars, then break line of sight together. Switch-control makes this a two-act escape. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner WITHOUT losing the wanted level. Chain the robberies on one heat streak — losing the stars resets the chain. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery = drive or enter a vehicle model the first time. 100 distinct models; garages help track. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-mo ability; a dense firefight (heist, gang op) gives 5+ targets in one activation. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Hidden joke trophy — per the name, an escape from the VCIA building in story context. Leave the way the mission does not intend. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rhino tank joke ('kinda hot in these Rhinos'). Hidden. Requires tank access — a military base or a mission scene; steal a Rhino and survive the heat. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Stealth approach: camera control, silent takedowns, case the store first. Alarm trips void it. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, silver 40G. Vault robberies are the prep-heavy jobs: crew, drill, getaway. Five different branches. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rob an armored truck and escape. Trucks spawn on routes; block, breach, take the bags, lose the heat. Easiest of the big robberies. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Explore all of Leonida, 20G. The map's discovery grid: visit every map cell. A chopper tour plus the highway loop covers most of it; zoom the map to find fog. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 total. Each gang runs one rackets location; hit all nine businesses once. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Hidden 5G. Sit at the Ocean Beach bar scene and take the drink prompt at the viewpoint spot. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — a Vice callback. Hidden 5G. Drive into the showroom and exit through the window glass. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Bowling alley follow-through at Kolt & Associates' alley — the bowling meme return. Hidden 5G. Complete the bowling scene with the follow-through prompt. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The lowdown: A partnership with mass appeal — hidden 5G. Tied to the Jason/Lucia partnership content; a shared activity that goes public. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Choices made (for better or worse) — 500 in total. Hidden 5G. The game's choice counter: 500 accumulated dialogue/action choices across the story. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Second time's the charm — hidden 5G. Replay-driven: an event that must be repeated once failed. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The lowdown: What the hell just happened? Hidden 5G. Unverified unlock per The Games Wiki — a scripted weird moment in the story. Sit back and enjoy it. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — hidden 5G. A bowling-related melee attack from a moving vehicle; the alley's pedestrians are the pins. Story-linked, so Sony hides the card until you pop it. (Cross-checked on GTA Wiki.)
sources: GTA Wiki — Achievements and Trophies in GTA VI (gta.wiki)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, 20G. Marked Bills come from robberies; laundering happens through contact networks over time. Start laundering early. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Spend $100,000 across all shops, 15G. Cumulative spend at any shops — weapons, clothes, food. Progress tracked silently. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Purchase all 8 garage properties, 15G. Garages are the buyable property type; all 8 on the map. Costs feed the money trophies too. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The lowdown: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, 15G. The vehicle-registration app: register any 10 distinct owned vehicles. (Cross-checked on GamesRadar+.)
sources: GamesRadar+ — Complete GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement list
